headline: Wall Street Analysts Think American Tower (AMT) Could Surge 27.3%: Read This Before Placing a Bet
summary: The average of price targets set by Wall Street analysts indicates a potential upside of 27.3% in American Tower (AMT). While the effectiveness of this highly sought-after metric is questionable, the positive trend in earnings estimate revisions might translate into an upside in the stock.
